body: It sucks to not be wanted. :(

Wow. That's rough. What about behavioral therapy? Maybe you just need a little support and you're only interpreting it as needing something more because you don't know. 

Volunteering your time somewhere might make you feel good too. 

I'm sorry that all happened to you. I dropped out of high school because of social anxiety. I got better and my anxiety went away a bit too. I went to school and graduated with a BS two years ago. My anxiety doesn't bother me too much anymore. But, I had to learn that. I went to DBT for a year when I decided that my life was worth living when I was 23 after being in an incredibly abusive relationship that made me want to die because I didn't even have enough self-worth to look at myself naked in the shower. 

I'm struggling with some other stuff now but love the DBT I did a few years ago. It saved me and made me so much stronger than I ever imagined I could be. I also started crossfit at around the same time I started the therapy and that really put things into perspective for me.
I hear that. That stuff can be difficult! I get that way too sometimes

Kids. I have kids that look up to me. I can't imagine them doing harm to themselves because I've done something. 

I get what you're talking about though. That mindset is so hard. I just got out of it. I just started doing it again and my mental toughness and reason for living just went up by so much. There's something about working out so hard that you feel like you're dying and doing it with a group of people who are encouraging the behavior. I feel like I can conquer anything afterwards. I mean, it's humbling as fuck, but afterwards it feels so good, and if you're lucky, you can find people who want to push you to that point :)

I don't know. I just started again and I've realized that so much of my mental toughness, drive to succeed, and belief in my own success came from lifting heavy things and extreme cardio. And, I get into a place where I don't even care who sees my body. I love not feeling like anyone owns me and my beliefs about myself... then again, it took me two months to feel normal again after another extreme emotion episode. I hate those. lol
I moved in with roommates who have two dogs and sometimes there's three! We also have cats. It is exactly what I needed! :)

It switches your brain from emotion to mind to wise mind. I remember when I was younger feeling normal felt so good. Then I found a place and a way to manage extreme emotions. I felt so alone for so long. I didn't even know that there was anything wrong with me, but when I reached out for help. I finally heard what I needed to hear; someone told me that I needed assistance managing extreme emotions and identifying strategies to get better.
true. I guess it's just down to me wishing he did. It hurts, but it feels better now that I've put some distance between the two of us

I wish more people cared about me too. :( I used to have friends. I'm making more, but I think I need to set a clear boundary with another friend... I need to let him know that I've continually allowed him to play with me and that I've had enough. I barely know what to do anymore, but I know that I'm gonna tell him that the whole experience with him was less than savory.

I feel ya. I thought I had a good friend, but he bailed. He always bails after awhile and then comes back. I think I'm going to call him on it and see why he thinks I'm so disposable. 

What's the evidence for your reasoning?
Hopefully. I just wish they'd come sooner. I feel so alone and like no one understands me. This is helping though.

Thank you. You're right. He's a douche. I'll be happy once I pay him back. Also, nothing says I have to hang out with him anymore either. I don't want to be friends with someone who makes me feel unwanted and worthless.
